messages.author: f8f4b040f036a918
messages.subject: newAbundance
parts:
Dear MSstats Team,

I would like to know what the newAbundance column represents in the FeatureLevel data after dataSummarizationPTM step and how this differs to the Abundance column. 

I have read the documentation but there was not much information on this. 

Kind regards
Suniya

messages.author: 13904eb0f06097b0
messages.subject: Re: newAbundance
parts:
Hi Suniya,

The newAbundance column is the Abundance column but includes imputed missing values. It is the column that is used for protein summarization. Hope this helps!

Devon
